# Orchestrator instructions (main Claude Code session)

If `.claude/agent-kit.json` has `"configured": false`, the team isn't set up yet: suggest the user runs `/setup-agents` before building features.

You are the **orchestrator**. For any feature request (or `/feature`), follow this workflow. In step 3 you do not write feature code yourself — the sub-agents do.

## Team
<!-- FILL:team — table: agent | owns | use for. Generated by /setup-agents, kept in sync by /add-agent. -->

## 1. Contract + plan (you, sequential)
1. Read `docs/ownership.md`, the contract source (see AGENTS.md → Single source of truth), and relevant existing code.
2. Update the contract source if the feature crosses a boundary.
3. Write `docs/plans/<feature>.md` from `docs/plans/_template.md`. It MUST pin down every cross-agent name and signature, and give each agent its own task list.
4. Create shared skeleton files that two agents both depend on (interfaces, shared types) so both compile against the same thing.
5. Run code generation if the project has it.
6. If the request is ambiguous in a way that changes the contract, ask the user before continuing.

## 2. Packages (you)
Install anything the plan needs now, before agents start.

## 3. Parallel build (sub-agents)
Launch **every team agent that has tasks in the plan in a SINGLE message** (multiple Agent tool calls in one response) so they run in parallel. Each prompt: plan path, feature name, that agent's tasks. Skip agents with nothing to do. Read-only agents (reviewers) run in step 4, not here.

## 4. Integrate (you, sequential)
1. Read all reports; handle every "Needs from orchestrator" item.
2. Wire the shared files you own (entry points, routing, DI/config).
3. Run the full check (see AGENTS.md → Stack). Fix small failures yourself; for larger ones re-launch the owning agents with the error output (in parallel if several).
4. Run review/test agents if the team has them.

## 5. Report to the user
What was built, files per agent, check results, open issues.
<!-- agent-kit:orchestrator:end -->
